routeProfiles.name: Sicily in June
routeProfiles.rationale: Sicily is highly fire-prone and the July 2026 island-wide emergency confirms that the consequence can be severe. Timing matters: the regional 2023 analysis found no critical fire conditions from early summer through mid-July before a sharp late-July surge. June is meaningfully safer than July, but not low-risk.

value.aggregation: The trip inherits the lowest safety score among its route profiles so one exposed base cannot be hidden by a low-risk base.
value.monitoring: Recheck official daily fire-danger maps and active incidents 14 days, 72 hours, and each morning before a rural drive or hike. A live red/extreme warning overrides this climatology.

sourceLocators.sicily-fire-history-2023: Regional report pp. 14–17: no critical June/early-July phase; July 24 surge; 74,341 hectares burned in Sicily in 2023

budget.rationale: Full cash planning band $14,000–$19,400, with no miles redemption, scores 1/5 against the $12,000 target and $15,000 preferred maximum. Existing supplier observations have not been refreshed.

weather.rationale: Sicily June weather remains favorable; Rome introduces recurring midday heat management.

fireRisk.rationale: Retains the existing conservative Sicily June moderate 5–10% planning band; not an actuarial prediction.

swim.rationale: Eight Sicily nights preserve frequent Ionian swims around 72–74°F; four Rome nights have no planned natural swimming.

variety.rationale: The scheduled coast, Etna, Baroque towns and ancient Rome give all three trip modes real time.

ease.rationale: Three bases, one car, one inter-base drive and a separate domestic flight; no one-night stops.

food.rationale: Sicily pizza and market food plus Rome pizza, pasta and groceries cover both children.

risk.rationale: Exact protected international open-jaw ticket and four-person domestic inventory remain unverified; four Rome nights buffer the separate flight.

nights.rationale: Twelve hotel nights produce 5/5 by the canonical rubric.

novelty.rationale: Sicily and Rome are absent from the documented visited-place list; no repeat stop is required.

pto.rationale: Nine weekdays after observed Juneteenth, including departure; PTO score 2 with zero default weight.
